name: Adaptive Atomic ReduCtion (ARC)
definition: ARC is a primitive that accelerates atomic operations in differentiable rendering by leveraging intra-warp locality (threads in a warp update the same memory location) and varying atomic traffic (subset of threads active). It reduces atomic requests sent to L2 by performing warp-level reduction in registers/SM cores and dynamically distributing remaining atomic computation between SM cores and L2 atomic units.
